Headquarters: Austria (remote); UK (remote)

Role Purpose: 

The Senior Customer Success Manager will own a portfolio of enterprise and mid-market accounts across EMEA. This is not a relationship management role — it is a value consulting role. You will bring deep expertise in fraud, identity, and compliance to help customers design optimal identity strategies and realize measurable risk reduction outcomes. You will be expected to understand your customers’ business deeply, make the value Jumio delivers visible and quantifiable, and act as the connective tissue between the value that was promised during the sale and the value the customer achieves.

You will work closely with Account Managers on renewal and expansion, with the implementation team during the critical customer onboarding and adoption stages, and with Product and Support to close the loop on customer feedback. You will be a named owner of customer health — accountable for knowing which accounts are at risk, why, and what you are doing about it.

This role is well-suited to someone who is commercially-minded, data-fluent, and energized by the complexity of enterprise customer relationships. You will be joining at a moment of intentional transformation — there is a significant opportunity to shape how Jumio’s customer success motion operates going forward.

Responsibilities:

Customer Health & Retention

• Own the health of a portfolio of EMEA enterprise and mid-market accounts — you are accountable for knowing which are green, yellow, or red and why

• Monitor customer health signals continuously: product utilization, support ticket trends, NPS, executive engagement, and contract consumption pace

• Identify early warning signs of dissatisfaction or disengagement before they surface as churn risk — act on health score drops immediately, don’t wait for the customer to raise the issue

• Own escalation when product gaps or recurring issues are impacting customer outcomes — and close the feedback loop by communicating back to the customer what Jumio is doing

• Ensure open support issues are resolved to the customer’s satisfaction and that unresolved issues never reach a renewal conversation

Fraud & Compliance Advisory

• Serve as a subject matter expert on fraud, identity verification, AML, and digital risk management for your customer portfolio

• Advise customer risk and fraud teams on emerging fraud vectors, industry best practices, and regulatory developments relevant to their business

• Evaluate customer risk profiles and provide expert recommendations on verification workflow optimization, risk mitigation, and user friction tradeoffs

• Identify compliance and regulatory hurdles that may impact product adoption and coordinate with internal teams to resolve them.

Value Realization & ROI

• Confirm customers are seeing the outcomes they expected — pass rates, conversion improvement, fraud reduction, compliance — and make that value visible and quantifiable

• Own the business outcomes scorecard for each account: track the metrics that matter to the customer and report on them proactively

• Prepare and lead regular business reviews (EBRs) that drive decisions — not just report on usage

• Connect Jumio’s performance back to the customer’s original business goals and make the ROI case clearly before the AM enters a commercial conversation

• Address gaps between what was promised during the sale and what the customer is experiencing — proactively, not reactive

Adoption & Platform Success

• Monitor feature adoption — ensure customers are using everything they paid for and that underutilized capabilities are proactively introduced

• Train new users as the customer’s team grows or changes, and keep the customer current on new features and product updates relevant to their use case

• Build a joint success plan aligned to the customer’s evolving business goals — a living document, not a one-time exercise

• Partner with the cross-functional teams during the post-go-live period to ensure customers reach full adoption

Relationships & Executive Engagement

• Build and maintain multi-threaded relationships across the customer organization — not just the day-to-day contact

• Expand relationships to business leaders and executives: a single-threaded account is a renewal risk

• Identify and nurture champions within each account who will advocate for Jumio internally

• Invite engaged customers into the Jumio community — user groups, advisory boards, reference programs

Expansion & Commercial Partnership

• Spot signals that a customer is ready for more — new use cases, new geographies, increased volume, new compliance requirements

• Surface expansion opportunities to the Account Manager with a clear business case grounded in the customer’s current deployment and proven value

• Support the AM in building the commercial case for expansion — you have the customer relationship and the data; the AM has the commercial motion

• Identify satisfied customers who could become references, case studies, or advisory board members

Skills, Experience and Qualifications:

• Multiple years of practitioner experience in Fraud, Identity, AML, or Digital Risk Management — you have worked inside a fraud or compliance function, not just sold to one

• Strong consultative and analytical thinking with a focus on risk strategy and workflow design

• Ability to distill complex fraud and compliance concepts into clear, value-driven narratives for executive stakeholders

• Proven track record managing enterprise accounts with $500K+ ARR — you have owned renewal conversations and have GRR/NRR data to support your candidacy

• Demonstrated ability to conduct executive-level business reviews that drive outcomes, not just report activity

• Experience building and maintaining customer health frameworks and success plans

• Commercial acumen: you understand the connection between customer health and revenue, and you can have credible conversations with economic buyers

• Data fluency: you are comfortable working with product usage data, building ROI narratives, and using a CS platform (Planhat, Gainsight, Totango, or equivalent)

• Strong communication and executive presence — you are as comfortable presenting to the C-Suite as you are troubleshooting with a technical team
Proactive by nature: you identify risks before customers do and you act without waiting to be asked

Preferred Qualifications:

• Familiarity with API-based or technically complex SaaS products — you do not need to be an engineer, but you need to be comfortable in technical conversations

• Experience working in a PE-backed or high-growth transformation environment

• Prior experience building or contributing to CS playbooks, health score models, or QBR frameworks

What Success Looks Like:

In your first 90 days:

• You have a clear health rating for every account in your portfolio and a plan for every yellow and red account

• You have met the key stakeholders at each account and established a regular operating cadence

• You understand the business outcomes each customer is trying to achieve and whether Jumio is delivering them

• You have identified the top 3 accounts at renewal risk and have an active plan in place

By end of year one:

• GRR across your portfolio is at or above target

• Every account has a current success plan, a health score, and an EBR cadence

• You have surfaced expansion opportunities to the AM team with qualified business cases

• Customer satisfaction scores across your portfolio are trending upward

Compensation:

We offer an annual full-time salary (38.5 hr week) of min 80,000 EUR gross, with a possible overpayment depending on qualifications and experience.

Jumio Values:

IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation 

Equal Opportunities:

Headquarters: Portugal - Remote

Be Part of Building the Future

Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost.  Learn more at www.dremio.com.
About the role

Dremio's Connectivity team builds the high-performance connectivity solutions that help customers bring data to Dremio and connect Dremio to the broader data ecosystem. The team works across client drivers, protocols, connectors, interoperability, distributed systems, and the reliability and supportability of production data access.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll independently own multiple medium-to-large features or service components within a Connectivity and Clients area. You'll define the approach for a substantial team-area scope, turn ambiguous goals into clear milestones, make sound feature and service-level design decisions, and drive work through reliable production delivery. You will bring deep expertise in at least one area, such as JDBC or ODBC drivers, Apache Arrow ADBC, Arrow Flight SQL, BI interoperability, source connectivity, or connectivity reliability, while contributing effectively across adjacent areas. You will also mentor engineers and influence partner teams through strong technical judgment and execution.

What you'll be doing

• Own substantial connectivity work: Lead multiple medium-to-large features or service components from problem definition through design, implementation, validation, release readiness, and operational handoff.

• Turn ambiguity into an execution plan: Define reviewable milestones, acceptance measures, dependencies, estimates, and risks for complex customer, product, and engineering goals.

• Design scalable, maintainable systems: Produce technical designs and architecture diagrams, explain trade-offs, and make feature and service-level decisions across drivers, protocols, client libraries, connectors, and distributed services.

• Diagnose complex failures: Lead root-cause analysis across client/server, protocol, network, authentication, metadata, and distributed-system boundaries using logs, telemetry, profiles, benchmarks, and production evidence.

• Build compatibility and reliability: Maintain API and protocol stability; create automated compatibility, interoperability, performance, scale, reliability, observability, and diagnostics coverage; and define practical migration paths for supported and legacy clients.

• Collaborate and influence: Partner with Product, Query Execution, QA, Support, SRE, Documentation, and external technology partners to resolve dependencies and improve certification, customer experience, and supportability.

• Raise the engineering bar: Participate actively in code and design reviews, mentor and coach engineers, improve team practices, and contribute to relevant upstream open-source projects when aligned with Dremio priorities.

• Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly: Apply Dremio-approved AI tools to code comprehension, debugging, test generation, and documentation while protecting proprietary and customer data and validating results through review, testing, and sound engineering judgment.

What we're looking for

• Staff-level ownership: 8+ years of production software engineering experience, or equivalent depth demonstrated through sustained ownership of complex systems and multiple substantial team-area features.

• Programming expertise: Deep proficiency in Java, C++, Rust, Go, or another systems or services language, with the ability to work effectively in adjacent languages and frameworks.

• Connectivity and systems depth: Experience designing and debugging APIs, protocols, client libraries, drivers, or distributed services, with strong knowledge of data structures, concurrency, asynchronous programming, networking, and failure handling.

• Problem-solving ability: Able to identify and solve non-obvious problems across client/server and distributed-system boundaries and turn findings into durable fixes and regression coverage.

• Quality mindset: Experience building comprehensive unit, integration, compatibility, performance, or reliability tests and working with production CI/CD, packaging, release, certification, and engineering quality controls.

• Communication and influence: Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs, surface risks early, align contributors across teams, and influence without formal authority.

• Mentorship: Demonstrated ability to mentor and coach engineers and improve the effectiveness and engineering practices of the team around you.

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degrees and equivalent industry experience are welcomed.

Bonus points if you have

• Experience developing JDBC, ODBC, ADBC, or other database drivers.

• Experience with Apache Arrow or Arrow Flight SQL.

• Experience with SQL engines, databases, data platforms, or source connectors.

• BI interoperability experience with Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar tools, including collaboration with partner engineering teams.

• Knowledge of OAuth, OIDC, TLS, enterprise authentication, metadata discovery, or query pushdown.

• Cross-platform native build, packaging, release engineering, compatibility certification, or upgrade support experience.

• Observability, production diagnostics, customer escalation, long-running data transfer, cancellation, keepalive, timeout, or proxy experience.

• Contributions to Apache Arrow or other relevant open-source projects.

What we value 

At Dremio, we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to People, Thinking, and Action. Our Gnarlies (that's what we call our employees) communicate with clarity, drive accountability, and are respectful towards each other. We confront brutal facts and focus on results while operating with a sense of urgency and building a "flywheel". People who like to jump in and drive momentum will thrive in our #GnarlyLife.

Dremio is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other unlawful factor.

Dremio is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

Dremio has policies in place to protect the personal information that employees and applicants disclose to us. Please click here to review the privacy notice. 

Important Security Notice for Candidates

At Dremio, we uphold trust and transparency as paramount values in all our interactions with customers, partners, employees, and the general public. We have been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will be from an @dremio.com domain. If you suspect you've been targeted by a scam, it's imperative to report the incident to your local law enforcement agencies. For more information about this type of scam, please refer to Dremio's official statement here.

Dremio is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.

PRODUCT MANAGER — HOTEL | FINKRAFT.AI 
 Location: Bengaluru, HSR | Full-time | Level: L4 | Reports to: CPO / BU Head 

ABOUT FINKRAFT.AI 

Finkraft.ai is a B2B SaaS company that enables enterprises to maximise GST claims on travel and expense data. The platform automates invoice collection, validation, and reconciliation across airlines and hotels — helping finance teams at McKinsey, BCG, Capgemini, Abbott, and 1,250+ enterprises improve compliance, visibility, and cash recovery. We've recovered ₹300Cr+ in GST claims and are scaling from $1.5M to $10M ARR in 18 months. 

The Hotel vertical is our primary growth unlock for the next 18 months. This PM owns it. 

THE PROBLEM YOU ARE SOLVING 

A corporate employee books a hotel through a TMC or GDS. The booking passes through a PMS like Opera Cloud. The invoice is generated by the hotel, sometimes routed through a Concur integration or a bank lodge card program. By the time the finance team tries to claim GST on that invoice, the corporate GSTIN is missing, the folio is incomplete, the tax breakdown is wrong, or the invoice never arrived. 

This happens at scale across every enterprise client Finkraft serves. Your job is to understand every node in that chain — hotel, PMS, GDS, OTA, TMC, Concur, bank, payment player — and build the product that fixes it. 

WHAT YOU WILL OWN IN 90 DAYS 

• Full ecosystem map completed: every player in the hotel invoicing and GST chain documented — where data breaks, who owns the fix, and what Finkraft's integration surface is at each node. 
 
• Field engagement calendar live: structured visit schedule across TMCs, hotel chains, corporates, and software companies — minimum 15 discovery meetings completed, findings structured into roadmap inputs. 
 
• One PRD shipped to engineering: based on field findings and existing client pain, a product spec written, reviewed, and in active development. 
 
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Product Strategy and Roadmap 
 
• Own the end-to-end product strategy for the Hotel vertical: what gets built, in what sequence, and why 
 
• Define the roadmap based on enterprise client pain, ecosystem partner signals, and competitive landscape — not internal assumptions 
 
• Present roadmap to leadership, Sales, and enterprise clients at QBRs; defend prioritisation decisions with data and customer evidence 
 
• Track roadmap delivery against committed timelines; own the gap between what was promised and what shipped 
 
Field Ecosystem Engagement 
 
• Conduct structured field meetings across the full hotel ecosystem: TMCs (BCD, CWT, FCM, SOTC), GDS providers (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport), OTAs (MakeMyTrip, Booking.com, Expedia), hotel chains and revenue management teams, PMS vendors (Opera Cloud, IDS, Hotelogix), corporate travel managers, expense platform teams (Concur, Happay, Zoho Expense), banks (for lodge card and virtual card programs), and payment platforms (Razorpay, HDFC SmartPay, Mastercard CEP) 
 
• Extract structured product intelligence from every field meeting: integration documentation, data flow maps, GSTIN handling gaps, invoice format standards, and API availability 
 
• Convert field findings into product inputs within 5 business days of every meeting — not raw notes, structured inputs 
 
Ecosystem Integration Ownership 
 
• Map data flow across the full chain: hotel PMS → GDS/OTA/TMC → Concur/expense tool → bank/payment → Finkraft → GST claim 
 
• Identify where corporate GSTIN, folio data, and invoice tax breakdowns break at each handoff 
 
• Define integration specifications for priority ecosystem partners; own the partner relationship through integration go-live 
 
• Maintain a live integration roadmap: what's in production, what's in development, what's blocked and why 
 
PRD and Engineering Partnership 
 
• Write clear, complete PRDs for every feature in development: problem statement, user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and success metrics 
 
• Partner with engineering through the full build cycle — not just handoff and review 
 
• Attend standups, unblock decisions in real time, and accept or reject releases based on defined criteria 
 
• Maintain a product backlog that engineering can execute against without PM involvement in every sprint decision 
 
Sales, BA, and CS Collaboration 
 
• Feed qualified product intelligence to Sales: what integrations exist, what gaps remain, and what client use cases are unlocked by each roadmap item 
 
• Work with Senior BAs on field observations — BA finds the problem, PM defines the fix 
 
• Support enterprise client conversations on product capability, integration timelines, and roadmap commitments — own what you say in the room 
 
• Partner with CS on rollout plans for new features: training, documentation, and client communication owned by PM, not CS 
 
Market and Regulatory Intelligence 
 
• Track GST regulatory changes relevant to hotel invoicing: e-invoicing thresholds, folio compliance requirements, GSTIN transmission mandates 
 
• Monitor hotel-tech landscape: new PMS entrants, GDS API changes, OTA invoicing policy shifts, Concur integration updates 
 
• Bring competitive signals into roadmap prioritisation — what are enterprise clients being offered by alternatives? 

Requirements

REQUIREMENTS 

Must Have 
 
• 4–6 years in product management in travel, hospitality, fintech, or enterprise B2B SaaS 
 
• Has conducted field discovery meetings with external ecosystem partners — not just internal user interviews 
 
• Working knowledge of corporate travel ecosystems: TMCs, GDS platforms, OTAs, PMS providers, and how they connect 
 
• Has shipped a B2B product that integrates with at least two external systems — understands what "integration complexity" actually means in production 
 
• Has written PRDs that engineering shipped from without PM hand-holding in every stand-up 
 
• Comfort with field-heavy, travel-intensive work across India 
 
Strong Preference 
 
• Has worked directly with Concur, SAP Concur integrations, or competing expense management platforms 
 
• Exposure to bank lodge card programs, virtual card reconciliation, or payment gateway integrations (Razorpay, HDFC, Mastercard) 
 
• Prior exposure to GST, e-invoicing, or indirect tax reconciliation 
 
• Has integrated with or mapped data flows from Opera Cloud, Amadeus, Sabre, or equivalent hotel/GDS platforms 
 
• Experience at a TMC, GDS, OTA, hotel chain, or hotel software company is a significant advantage

8833bc7a53e3d873.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,  you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

The Role: As a PM2, you will independently own a product area or platform charter end-to-end — from strategy and roadmap to execution and business impact. You will operate with significant autonomy and drive initiatives across customer experience, platform scalability, automation, growth, and monetization. You will be expected to think beyond features and solve for systems, operational leverage, and long-term platform evolution.


What you’ll do?

1. Build Customer Empathy - Regularly engage with customers, internal stakeholders, and ecosystem partners to deeply understand pain points, workflows,            and unmet needs through both qualitative and quantitative insights.

2. Drive Product Strategy - Define long-term product vision and quarterly roadmap aligned with business goals, customer outcomes, and platform scalability.

3. Build Scalable Products - Collaborate with engineering, design, analytics, and operations teams to build reliable, scalable, and high-impact products.

4. Lead Product Execution - Write high-quality product specifications, prioritize effectively, manage tradeoffs, and ensure timely execution across releases

5. Own Metrics & Outcomes - Define success metrics, monitor business impact, and driveiterative improvements through experimentation and data analysis.

6. Ecosystem Collaboration - Partner with banks, regulators, vendors, and ecosystem players to co-build industry-defining solutions.


What are we looking for?

1. 4–7 years of product management experience

2. Strong product execution and prioritization skills

3. Experience owning business metrics and customer outcomes

4. Strong analytical thinking and experimentation mindset

5. Ability to work across technical and business stakeholders

6. Systems thinking and platform orientation

7. Strong customer empathy balanced with business acumen

8. Ability to thrive in ambiguity and fast-paced environments

 

Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.
